title: Chariot: unobstructed orthogonal range on an open board
rationale: Chariot d4 on an otherwise empty board reaches every square of its file and rank and nothing else: all twelve, out to a4, g4, d1 and d7, pinning "any number of unobstructed squares orthogonally". The four diagonal steps are rejected, pinning that the movement is orthogonal only. The remaining two legal moves are the red king's palace steps; d4a4 and d4d7 pin a three-square slide, and d4d7 checks the black king along rank 7.
